decision_cruda.rationale: N600-11 is stopped for 5-8 h, so LH-04 is idle. Activating RS-N600-02 (11.5 g/t, 419 t, same Norte level 600) with LH-04 is the best use. It takes 1 h to activate, which leaves about 6 h of loading. At about 28-40 t/h that is roughly 170-240 t, or 60-90 oz, and the stockpile has room. No loader is down, so there are no loans to make.
